title: Albertsons Companies integrates Safeway grocery shopping into ChatGPT
excerpt: The retailer is expanding its partnership with OpenAI to allow customers to build carts and plan meals directly within the ChatGPT interface.
bodyHtml:
Albertsons Companies announced on October 1, 2026, that it is expanding its partnership with OpenAI to incorporate AI-powered shopping experiences into its retail operations. The initiative allows customers to use ChatGPT to plan meals, build digital shopping lists, and select products for checkout at Safeway stores.

The company is also utilizing ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API to assist internal teams with retail technology development, promotional insights, and data-driven decision-making. These tools are being used to help teams navigate complexity, accelerate workflows, and move promising ideas toward production faster.

Albertsons Companies plans to extend these AI-powered shopping capabilities beyond Safeway to its other brands, including Albertsons, Vons, Jewel-Osco, Shaw’s, ACME, and Tom Thumb. The retailer currently operates more than 2,200 stores and serves over 36 million customers each week.
topic: How Albertsons Companies is reimagining retail from the inside out
